purpose: Consolidate dated evidence across six distinct editions/operations and select one bounded next investigation.
rubricStatus: Research proposal only; existing engine and minimum-three publication threshold unchanged.

statusSemantics.observed: Only the bounded operation actually performed.
statusSemantics.documented: Dated vendor statement recorded in earlier receipt; not refreshed or independently certified here.
statusSemantics.partial: Some evidence exists; material scope may remain unresolved.
statusSemantics.unresolved: Unknown, not a negative privacy finding.
statusSemantics.material-unresolved: Known relevant data path still unresolved; blocks a positive research classification.

qualificationPrinciples: Do not require proof that no packet can ever be sent as a universal privacy definition.
A material unresolved selected-operation text-data path blocks a positive classification; limited negative observations cannot close it.
Telemetry is not automatically submitted prose; no-training, no-account, offline support and retention are distinct.
Access/entitlement dependency is not a privacy defect; no owner purchase requested.
Privacy research may allow subscriptions; do not import no-subscription route constraints.
Same product name does not make hosted, Classic, HTTP and direct CLI evidence interchangeable.
provenanceHashNormalization: UTF-8 CRLF-to-LF only; every other character remains significant.
